US Election Officials Face Scrutiny Over Voting Issues and Foreign Threats

US election officials are facing scrutiny over voting site issues in rural Alaska, where lawsuits allege sites failed to open before Election Day. Concurrently, concerns are being raised about foreign threats to the electoral process, with AI chatbots identified as a new vector for spreading election falsehoods. Election officials are also reportedly worried about Department of Justice monitoring of Tuesday's vote. The coverage notes that Democratic warnings about threats to democracy are facing an 'uncomfortable reckoning' following an Alaska election report.
